status: PROPOSED 2026-11-03, not approved: PLAN.md Phase 4 says the owner sets the pass threshold in advance. No report has been generated and no LLM has been called.
plan: PLAN.md Phase 4: an 8D incident report from a drift-table row, a groundedness check, an eval of 20 to 30 synthetic drift scenarios with known findings scored for correctness and groundedness with cost and latency per call, and a human review queue

scenarios.built_by: scripts/phase4_scenarios.py (cdm.scenarios), committed before any generator exists
scenarios.staged: all 30 are synthetic (staged): made-up scores run through the monthly job's own drift tests; no real image, patient or month is in them, and no number from them is ever reported as a drift result
scenarios.known_findings: cdm.scenarios.expected_findings(record): severity, overall alert, alerting skin types, new sources, containment, whether delayed accuracy is available, and the caveats a correct report must state; derived from the record, never typed by hand

model: Gemini, free tier (owner's decision 2026-11-03); the exact model ID is fixed in the generator PR before any live call
input: one scenario record (the same JSON shape as a gold_drift_monthly summary) and nothing else
output: an 8D report as JSON: problem, containment, root cause, permanent fix, verification, prevention (prose), plus structured findings in the same fields as known_findings, plus a list of numeric claims, each naming the record field it comes from

scoring.groundedness: every number in the report's prose and claims must match a value in its scenario record (cdm groundedness check, to be built in its own PR; rounding rules fixed there before any live call). A report with any unmatched number is ungrounded
scoring.correctness: the structured findings equal the known findings on every field, and every expected caveat is stated. For no_drift scenarios the correct output is 'no incident' (no 8D report)
scoring.scenario_result: passes if at least 2 of its 3 runs pass
scoring.provider_outage: a call that fails at the provider after retries (quota, timeout, 5xx) is an outage, not a wrong answer: it is counted apart and the run is not scored

thresholds_proposed.pass: at least 27 of 30 scenarios pass (90%) AND no scored run anywhere in the eval contains an ungrounded number
thresholds_proposed.inconclusive: more than 3 scenarios have fewer than 2 scored runs because of outages: reported as inconclusive (exit 2), never as a pass

tracked_per_call: outcome: ok, outage or invalid output
dollar cost (0 on the free tier; tokens still recorded)
where_it_runs: a manual (workflow_dispatch) GitHub workflow in an Environment that needs the owner's approval; CI replays recorded responses and never calls an LLM (owner's instruction, 2026-11-03)
